hero.h1: Shared group day trips from Marrakech & Fes
hero.lead: No private-tour price tag, no solo road-tripping logistics — just a shared minivan (or a local guide on foot), and a small group of fellow travelers, out and back the same day. Pick your city to see every route, from €20 per person.

cards.title: Day Trips from Marrakech
cards.blurb: A medina walking tour, the Atlas Mountains, the Agafay stone desert, Ouzoud Waterfalls, Essaouira, and the Ait Benhaddou kasbah route.

cards.title: Day Trips from Fes
cards.blurb: The Blue City of Chefchaouen, Roman ruins at Volubilis, the Middle Atlas cedar forest, and the hidden-gem towns of Sefrou & Bhalil.

sections.lead: From quick Marrakech experiences to full-day escapes from Fes, these original small-group activities make it simple to see more of Morocco without arranging a private driver.

cards.title: Marrakech Medina Walking Tour
cards.blurb: Discover Jemaa el-Fnaa, souks, Bahia Palace and hidden medina lanes with a local guide.

cards.title: Ourika Valley & Atlas Mountains
cards.blurb: Meet mountain communities, walk beside the river and enjoy the High Atlas foothills.

cards.title: Agafay Desert Sunset Escape
cards.blurb: Trade the city for a golden-hour camel ride and a Moroccan dinner beneath the Atlas horizon.

cards.title: Ouzoud Waterfalls Day Trip
cards.blurb: See Morocco's famous cascades, walk the olive groves and spot Barbary macaques near the falls.

cards.title: Essaouira Atlantic Coast
cards.blurb: Explore a breezy UNESCO-listed medina, fishing harbor, ramparts and Atlantic seafood.

cards.title: Ait Benhaddou & Ouarzazate
cards.blurb: Cross the High Atlas to a cinematic mud-brick kasbah and the gateway to the desert.

cards.title: Chefchaouen Blue City
cards.blurb: Wander the blue-washed Rif mountain medina, Kasbah Museum and Plaza Uta el-Hammam.

cards.title: Meknes, Volubilis & Moulay Idriss
cards.blurb: Combine imperial gates, Roman mosaics and the hilltop holy town of Moulay Idriss.

cards.title: Ifrane & Middle Atlas Cedar Forest
cards.blurb: See a different side of Morocco with alpine scenery, cedar forests and mountain villages.

cards.title: Sefrou & Bhalil Hidden Villages
cards.blurb: Slow down in two characterful Middle Atlas towns known for waterfalls, crafts and local life.

cta.p: Skip the taxi-rank haggling — book a fixed-price shared or private airport transfer in Marrakech or Fes.
